(3) The min_turns floor: with facility_proof, captives_confirmed_alive and a national_detention_network_known (or architects_strategy_known) fact established so bridge_1c_infiltration_needed fires and facility_infiltration_needed is true, assert the scene is still 1C while turns_since_entry < 7 and becomes 2A on the first turn at or after 7.
(4) The loader refuses a pacing event whose at_turn exceeds its scene's min_turns: build the smallest modified copy of the package source (or use an existing loader test fixture; see tests/ for how other tests construct invalid packages) and assert StoryPackageError mentions the floor.

(6) Clarification does not advance pacing: if the repo has a ClarificationTurn / engine-refusal path you can trigger from the stub provider (read ClarificationTurn and EngineRefusalTurn in engine.py), assert turn_index and fired_event_ids unchanged after it. If you cannot construct it in under 40 lines, skip it and explain why in the notes.
(7) Missed window today: advance 1C with accepted no-op turns past terminal_sweep_1c (turn 7) with none of facility_proof, captives_confirmed_alive or either C fact earned; assert the facts security_1c / terminal_sweep_1c set become true, and that facility_infiltration_needed is NOT true and the scene is not 2A, until the handoff deadline at handoff_after_turns (11); then record in the test what the deadline backstop does at turn 11 (assert the actual result, whatever it is).
